subject: Kickoff: Supplier intake playbook & action grid — AvaTech setup
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <j.miles@avatech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Supplier intake playbook & action grid — AvaTech setup

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for confirming the engagement. To keep things moving on our side, I wanted to run through a short intake playbook and the initial action grid so both teams know what to expect for vendor setup and PO routing. Below is our suggested split of responsibilities (what we need from you / what we’ll do):

What we need from AvaTech (please return within 5 business days if possible):
- Completed supplier questionnaire (attached) — contact details, legal entity name, tax ID
- Signed W-9 or local tax equivalent (if available)
- ACH or bank details for vendor payments (bank letter or voided check)
- Cert of insurance (COI) and primary contact for escalations
- Standard invoice sample (PDF) and preferred remittance email

What Redwood will deliver / do next:
- Create vendor record and generate Redwood vendor code
- Provide PO template and PO number format for your invoices
- Confirm payment terms and routing to Finance (cc: Priya)
- Share a short onboarding doc + Drive folder for artifacts

Attachments: AvaTech_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF) — we’ll use this to prefill the vendor record.

Next steps: Jordan, can you confirm a point of contact for legal/tax and a preferred date to complete the questionnaire? I’ll loop in Finance (Priya Natarajan) once we have the W-9 and bank details so they can provision payments.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Vendor Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0124

[Attachment: AvaTech_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Miles <j.miles@avatech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AvaTech Purchasing <purchasing@avatech.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Supplier intake playbook & action grid — AvaTech setup

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear list.

Quick answers:
- I’m the primary contact for vendor setup (Jordan Miles, Finance Ops).
- I’ve attached our signed W-9 and a sample invoice.
- We can provide ACH details; security team prefers a secure link or DocuSign for bank forms.
- COI is with our broker; I’ve requested a PDF and will send it once received (ETA 48 hours).

We also prefer PO numbers to be embedded in the invoice filename and in the invoice header — happy to match whatever format you provide.

On the timeline, I’ll complete the questionnaire and return it by Friday, Jul 22. If you need anything earlier, let me know.

Best,
Jordan Miles
Finance Ops | AvaTech Systems
j.miles@avatech.com
(206) 555-7780

[Attachments: W-9_AvaTech.pdf (PDF), AvaTech_Sample_Invoice.pdf (PDF)]

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickoff: Supplier intake playbook & action grid — AvaTech setup

Soojin / Marcus —

Great kickoff. A couple operational notes from procurement and Finance so we can minimize back-and-forth:

1) PO provisioning: I’ll create a one-off vendor code and a PO template for AvaTech (see attached draft CSV). Once Jordan confirms the preferred PO placement on the invoice we’ll lock the filename convention.
2) Payment terms: Redwood default is Net 30; if AvaTech needs Net 45/60 we’ll need commercial approval (let me know).
3) Invoicing: please request that AvaTech include the PO number, vendor code, and remittance email on each invoice to avoid delays.
4) Secure bank intake: Priya will provide a secure upload link (or DocuSign) for ACH info — do not send bank details over plain email.

I’ll take action to create the vendor record after we receive the completed questionnaire + W-9. Marcus — can you confirm whether we should flag this as an NDA-associated vendor (we may want to restrict certain data flows)?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: PO_Template_Redwood.csv (CSV)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <j.miles@avatech.com>

Subject: RE: Kickoff: Supplier intake playbook & action grid — AvaTech setup

Jordan —

Great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next checklist items and target dates:
- You: return completed questionnaire + COI + any bank verification by end of day Friday, Jul 22.
- AvaTech: include sample invoice with PO field indicated (helps our AP mapping).
- Redwood: Vanessa will provision vendor code and PO template; Priya will send secure link for ACH.

I’ve also shared a Drive folder (link below) where you can upload the documents. Once we have everything we’ll issue the first PO and confirm payment terms. If anything changes on your side on timing, please flag here.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3C-Redwood-AvaTech-Intake
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/avatech-vendor-agreement

Thanks again — looking forward to getting you set up.
